cues.en: All along during development, we were managing our containers using the command line makefiles and the Docker desktop app.
cues.zh: 開發期間，我們一直透過命令列、Makefile 和 Docker Desktop 管理容器。

cues.en: As at the time of this recording, there is no way to install Docker desktop on your server.
cues.zh: 在錄製這堂課時，還無法在伺服器安裝 Docker Desktop。

cues.en: But don't worry.
cues.zh: 但不用擔心。

cues.en: Here is a tool called Portainer comes to the rescue.
cues.zh: 可以用 Portainer 這個工具。

cues.en: As a reminder, Portainer is a container management platform that can run on a server.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，Portainer 是能在伺服器執行的容器管理平台。

cues.en: It allows you to easily build and manage containers in Docker, Docker, swarm, Kubernetes, etc. there are two versions of Portainer, a free community edition which we are going to be using, and a paid
cues.zh: 可以輕鬆建置與管理 Docker、Docker Swarm、Kubernetes 等容器；有免費 Community Edition，也有付費，

cues.en: version.
cues.zh: 版本。

cues.en: Of course, we are going to be using the Free Community Edition, so the first thing we need to do is we need to SSH into our server like I have.
cues.zh: 我們使用免費的 Community Edition；首先像我一樣，透過 SSH 登入伺服器。

cues.en: Then we shall use the docker command to first create a volume that Portainer shall use to store its database.
cues.zh: 先用 Docker 指令建立磁碟區，供 Portainer 儲存資料庫。

cues.en: And since we added our user to the docker group, we don't need to run the docker command with sudo.
cues.zh: 因為使用者已加入 docker 群組，所以不用 sudo。

cues.en: So we can just say docker volume.
cues.zh: 使用 docker volume。

cues.en: Create portainer underscore data like that.
cues.zh: create portainer_data。

cues.en: Then to confirm that the volume was created we can say Docker volume and less.
cues.zh: 用 docker volume ls，確認磁碟區已建立。

cues.en: And you can see we have the portainer data volume.
cues.zh: 可以看到 portainer_data。

cues.en: Then we're also going to create a network that all our services are going to run on in production.
cues.zh: 再建立正式環境所有服務使用的網路。

cues.en: As you can see, Docker network create, then the network is going to be called next gen underscore production network like that.
cues.zh: 使用 docker network create，網路名稱是 nextgen_prod_network。

cues.en: Then to confirm that the network was created we're going to get a response that looks like this.
cues.zh: 建立後，會得到像這樣的回應。

cues.en: Or we can only say Docker network ls good.
cues.zh: 也可以用 docker network ls，很好。

cues.en: And as you can see we have the next gen prod network.
cues.zh: 可以看到 nextgen_prod_network。

cues.en: Then we're going to download and install Portainer using Docker container shall run on the same network that we just created.
cues.zh: 接著透過 Docker 容器下載安裝 Portainer，使用剛才建立的相同網路。

cues.en: So you can say docker run.
cues.zh: 使用 docker run。

cues.en: Then in detached mode dash d then we specify the port is going to be we're going to map port 8000 to port 8000.
cues.zh: -d 表示背景執行，再設定 ports，把 8000 映射到 8000。

cues.en: Then we're also going to expose another port 94439443.
So these are the ports that contain a ransom.
cues.zh: 這些是 Portainer 使用的連接埠。

cues.en: Then we're going to name our container Portainer.
cues.zh: 容器名稱設為 portainer。

cues.en: Then we're going to specify the network with Dash dash network.
cues.zh: 再用 --network 指定網路。

cues.en: And that's going to be next gen underscore production prod network.
cues.zh: 值為 nextgen_prod_network。

cues.en: Then we're going to declare the restart policy.
cues.zh: 接著宣告重新啟動原則。

cues.en: And we want to restart Portainer always.
cues.zh: 希望 Portainer 一律重新啟動，所以使用 always。

cues.en: Then we specify the volume.
cues.zh: 再指定磁碟區。

cues.en: and the volume is going to be a slash, then slash run, then slash Docker dot sock.
cues.zh: 來源是 /var/run/docker.sock。

cues.en: And we're going to map that to slash slash run slash docker dot sock like that.
cues.zh: 映射到 /var/run/docker.sock。

cues.en: Then we specify another volume that's going to be for the portainer data.
cues.zh: 另一個磁碟區是 portainer_data。

cues.en: That's going to be slash data.
cues.zh: 映射到 /data。

cues.en: Then after specifying the volume, we're now going to specify the image that we're going to be using.
cues.zh: 磁碟區設定完成，再指定映像檔。

cues.en: And we're going to be using Portainer slash Portainer hyphen Community Edition, the LTS version.
cues.zh: 使用 portainer/portainer-ce，標籤是 lts。

cues.en: Then we can run the command.
cues.zh: 接著執行指令。

cues.en: Good to confirm that the Portainer container is running.
cues.zh: 很好，要確認 Portainer 容器正在執行，

cues.en: We can now say docker PS and we can see the Portainer container.
cues.zh: 可以用 docker ps，會看到 Portainer。

cues.en: Then to confirm that the Portainer is running on the network that we had defined, we're going to say docker network inspect next gen underscore prod network.
cues.zh: 再用 docker network inspect nextgen_prod_network，確認它在指定網路。

cues.en: Then in our response object under the containers we're going to see that we have the Portainer container.
cues.zh: 回應物件的 Containers 裡，會看到 Portainer 容器。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Then let's go back to our browser then go back to DigitalOcean.
cues.zh: 回到瀏覽器，再到 DigitalOcean。

cues.en: We're going to copy the IP address.
cues.zh: 複製 IP 位址。

cues.en: Then in a new tab we're going to navigate to Https.
cues.zh: 開新分頁，使用 HTTPS。

cues.en: Then the IP address on port nine 443.
cues.zh: 後面接 IP 位址，連接埠是 9443。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: When you navigate to this route, you're going to get a warning that this site is dangerous and our connection is not private.
cues.zh: 開啟時會警告網站危險，連線不是私密連線。

cues.en: This is because we do not have a valid SSL certificate for Portainer.
cues.zh: 因為 Portainer 沒有有效的 SSL 憑證。

cues.en: For now this is okay.
cues.zh: 講者這裡認為暫時可以接受。

cues.en: But for now what you can do is you can click on advanced, then proceed to the unsafe site.
cues.zh: 先點 Advanced，再選擇繼續前往不安全的網站。

cues.en: And remember, we don't necessarily need to serve portainer on a subdomain and issue an SSL certificate because we're going to be using portainer internally just to monitor and manage our containers.
cues.zh: 講者說明，Portainer 只供內部監控與管理容器，不一定要用子網域並發放 SSL 憑證。

cues.en: So we could as well just proceed with the note secure IP address and port like this.
cues.zh: 因此示範直接用這樣的 IP 位址與連接埠。

cues.en: Because this Portainer instance is going to be internal, it's not going to be exposed to the outside world.
cues.zh: 講者把這個 Portainer 實例描述為內部使用、不對外公開。

cues.en: Then once you've navigated to this page, what you can do is we're going to create a username and a password so I can leave mine as admin.
cues.zh: 到這個頁面後，建立使用者名稱與密碼，我使用 admin。

cues.en: Then the password I can make it pass 12345678 then repeat it.
cues.zh: 示範密碼設為 pass12345678，再輸入一次。

cues.en: Then click on create user.
cues.zh: 點 Create User。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: If at all.
cues.zh: 如果，

cues.en: In that process you get a message stating that Portainer timed out for security reasons.
cues.zh: 過程中提示 Portainer 因安全因素而逾時，

cues.en: You can restart the instance by just going back to the server and saying Docker restart portainer like that, but I'm not going to be running that command.
cues.zh: 可以回到伺服器，用 docker restart portainer 重新啟動；但我現在不會執行。

cues.en: I just wanted to show you the command to run in case you get an error message while trying to create a user, and the error message will most likely tell you something about Portainer timing out for security
cues.zh: 只是展示遇到建立使用者錯誤時，可以執行的指令；訊息通常會說 Portainer 因為安全，

cues.en: reasons.
cues.zh: 因素而逾時。

cues.en: And I am mentioning that because at times on this community edition, there's that bug.
cues.zh: 特別提這點，是因為 Community Edition 偶爾會有這個問題。

cues.en: Once in a while it appears and that's how to solve it.
cues.zh: 有時會出現，這是解決方式。

cues.en: Then once you've logged into your dashboard, you can click on home, then click on local.
cues.zh: 登入儀表板後，點 Home，再點 local。

cues.en: Then within our dashboard, you're going to be able to see that we have a zero stacks, one container, one volume, one image, and four networks.
cues.zh: 儀表板會顯示 0 個 stack、1 個容器、1 個磁碟區、1 個映像檔，以及 4 個網路。

cues.en: So now you can use Portena to manage your Docker containers just the same way you would use the command line.
cues.zh: 現在可以用 Portainer 管理 Docker 容器，就像使用命令列。

cues.en: Anything you can do with the containers in the command line.
cues.zh: 在命令列能對容器做的事，

cues.en: You can now use Portainer to do exactly that so you can inspect the volume.
cues.zh: 也可以透過 Portainer 完成，例如查看磁碟區。

cues.en: Go back, you can inspect the container and we only have the portena container and it's running like that.
cues.zh: 回來也能查看容器，目前只有 Portainer 容器，而且正在執行。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: That's basically it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課主要就是這些。
